settings.title: Visibly smooths and perfects skin, instantly
settings.text: This colour-adapting foundation glides on like silk, instantly blurring the look of fine lines, pores and uneven texture. Rather than settling into wrinkles, it moves with your skin for a smooth, natural finish that still looks like skin, just more even, softer and more refined.
settings.caption: After a single application

settings.title: Softens the look of crepey neck skin
settings.text: It blends seamlessly from face to neck, minimising the look of crepey texture while leaving a smooth, soft-focus finish. Because the shade adapts to your own tone, you can use the same foundation everywhere with no visible lines or colour mismatch.

settings.title: Restores your skin's "bounce"
settings.text: When skin loses its spring, it doesn't bounce back the way it used to, and that can make fine lines look deeper. Skin-loving glycerin and vitamin E help skin look plumper, smoother and more supple from the very first wear.
settings.caption: Visibly plumper-looking skin

settings.title: Helps fade the look of dark spots
settings.text: Inspired by Korean skincare, this formula does more than simply mask uneven areas. It helps visibly soften the appearance of dark spots, discolouration and older marks, giving an even, natural-looking finish that never looks heavy.

settings.title: Built-in SPF 15
settings.text: Everyday SPF 15 adds a light layer of protection against incidental sun, the kind that quietly leads to dark spots, fine lines and dullness. Lightweight, invisible and easy to wear every day. Under the Australian sun, always pair it with a dedicated broad-spectrum sunscreen for longer time outdoors.

settings.title: A fraction of the price of salon treatments
settings.text: Why pay for expensive salon facials and department-store creams? This formula gives a visibly smoother, refreshed and polished look at home, without appointments, downtime or the luxury price tag.
